notes: v2: the plan is built from MODULES. Lessons inside a module are fixed and the same for everyone. The quiz decides the ORDER of modules (after Module 1, which is always first) and the reason shown for each.
Personalize the surface, keep the path the same: lesson variants (in person / phone / not noticed yet) change examples and tasks, never which lesson comes next.

Input: tags from quiz.json (incl. derivedTags) and the branch. Output of planBuilder: whatWeHeard, beforeAfter, planIntro, modules[] in order (each with reason and lessons), firstLessonId, quickGuides (highlighted ones first), loaderLines, giftPhraseIds, readiness.
Placeholders as in quiz.json. Lessons 'm1_l1' to 'm1_l3' are built (m1_l2 and m1_l3 are drafts awaiting content-owner review); 'm1_l4' is next.
algorithm: 1. Module 'm1_talking' is always first, with reason firstModule.reasonByBranch[branch].
2. If the branch is 'noticing', module 'm0_before' is always second, with its fixed reason. Otherwise it is not in the plan.
3. Every other module in 'modules' with order 'scored' starts at its baseScore and its default reason.

4. Go through 'boosts' in order. A boost matches when ALL tags in 'all' are present, AT LEAST ONE in 'any' (if given), and NONE in 'none'. Add its points to that module. If this boost's points are the highest added so far to that module, its reason replaces the module's reason.
5. Sort scored modules by score, high to low; ties keep the order in 'modules'.
6. Modules with order 'later' always come last, in their listed order, with their default reason and status 'later'.
7. 'First 30 days' = Module 1 plus the next two modules in the list. The plan preview shows them in full and the rest as a short map.
8. Quick guides are always available. Guides whose 'highlightIf' tags match are shown first, marked 'For now'.
9. Every module shown must have a reason. Never show a module without one.

whatWeHeard.title: What we heard
rules: Skip a sentence if none of its slots have an answer.
Never include health changes (Q5) in this summary.
If 'work' is empty, end the helpers sentence with a period.
whatWeHeard.example: Mom was diagnosed in the last few months. Mom lives far away. You're handling most of it alone, and you work full-time. What worries you most: knowing what to say and legal papers and money.

noticing.before: Today: you've noticed changes in {recipient} and aren't sure what they mean or how to bring them up.
noticing.after: In 30 days: you know what's worth raising with a doctor, you've had a calm talk with {recipient}, and you have phrases that work when the same questions come up.

recent.before: Today: the diagnosis came with a brochure, and you don't know what to say when {recipient} asks the same question again and again.
recent.after: In 30 days: you have phrases that work, practiced out loud, key papers on track, and a plan your family can see.

changing.before: Today: things are changing, and every day brings a new hard moment.
changing.after: In 30 days: you have calm ways to handle the hard moments, a steadier routine, and a care card anyone who helps can use.

giftPhrases.rule: Take phrases whose tags match the Q5 answers first (in Q5 order, max 2 per tag), then fill with phrases tagged 'general' until there are 5. Source: phrases.json.

readiness.description: Readiness ring on Today: 'x of y lessons done' for the first 30 days (Module 1 + the next two modules).
